November 20, 1938. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao (Evening Edition) published the following comment
on November 19 :-

RUDENESS OF THE RUSSIAN REGIMENT, S.V.C.

(金神中学), Two days ago, students of Gonzaga College
led by an American Father, called at the camp
of the Lone Battalion on Kiaochow Road to console the men.
Two of the students, however, were assaulted and injured
by a white Russian guard at the camp. The affair has
aroused much indignation among the public and negotiations
have been opened with the S.M.C.

An unfortunate affair occurred in August over
the hoisting of a Chinese flag by the Lone Battalion,
but a satisfactory solution was found through the efforts
of Mr. Yu Ya-ching. Now, a case of assault of two
students by the Russian Regiment, S.V.C., has taken place
in the camp.

The present case occurred during a dispute
over the closing of a door. One whose duty it is to
guard the place refused to close the door. Then whose
duty is it to close the door? A member of the Battalion
closed the door and the matter should have ended there.
Nevertheless, the Russian guard assaulted two young
students and injured them.

The visit to the Lone Battalion made by the
students of Gonzaga College is quite in order, therefore
we are at a loss to understand the motive of such a
wanton act. It is not to be wondered at that the
American Father will take action.

It makes us sad to see the discipline of the
Russian Regiment so bad. The white Russian guard
has committed acts of violence on more than one occasion.
Cannot they be controlled? Trouble may arise in future
should such barbarous acts be allowed to continue.
In that event, who will be responsible?

We hope that the S.M.C. will deal properly
with the barbarous members of the Russian Regiment so as
to avoid further incidents.
pages.zh:
1938年11月20日。晨间译件。

《新闻报》（晚刊）于11月19日发表如下评论：

俄国团之无礼行为，商团义勇队。

（金神中学），两天前，金科中学（Gonzaga College）的学生在一位美国神父的带领下，前往胶州路孤军营慰问官兵。然而，两名学生遭到营内一名白俄卫兵殴打致伤。此事激起公众极大愤慨，目前已与工部局展开交涉。

今年八月，曾发生因孤军悬挂中国国旗而引发的不幸事件，但经虞洽卿先生努力，得以圆满解决。如今，商团义勇队俄国团在营地内又发生了殴打两名学生的事件。

本案起因于关于关闭一扇门的争执。负责守卫该处的人员拒绝关门。那么，关门究竟是谁的职责？一名孤军士兵关上了门，事情本应就此了结。然而，那名俄国卫兵却袭击了两名年轻学生并致其受伤。

金科中学学生探访孤军营是完全正当的行为，因此我们难以理解这种肆意妄为的动机。这位美国神父采取行动也就不足为奇了。

看到俄国团的纪律如此败坏，令我们感到痛心。这名白俄卫兵已不止一次实施暴力行为。难道无法对他们加以管束吗？如果允许这种野蛮行径继续下去，将来可能会引发麻烦。若真发生这种情况，谁来承担责任？

我们希望工部局妥善处置俄国团中的野蛮分子，以避免进一步的事件发生。

Globe (Editorial) :-

Advice to S.M.C. Over the Lone Battalion Problem

A case occurred a few days ago in the camp
of the Lone Battalion, wherein a member of the Russian
Regiment of the S.V.C. unreasonably assaulted two pupils
who had called to console the Battalion. Such action
on the part of the Russian Regiment causes one to
sympathize with the S.M.C. which is working hard to
deal with the situation.
With every sincerity, we submit the following
advice and hope that the S.M.C. will accept it :-
The Lone Battalion withdrew into the
International Settlement at the request of a third party
for the sake of the safety of the Settlement. From the
legal point of view, they are not prisoners, and it is
only natural that the wise S.M.C. will not treat the
Battalion as war prisoners. To our knowledge, the
Settlement authorities have always adopted an attitude
of respect towards the Battalion during the past 12 months
of its detention.
On the outbreak of the incident in the camp
of the Lone Battalion over the hoisting of a Chinese flag,
the S.M.C. dealt with the situation with great care and
the affair was settled in a satisfactory manner. This
is proof that the Council has no hostility whatever
towards the Lone Battalion. No doubt, shameless dogs
were responsible for the insult to the Lone Battalion in
order to create bad feeling between the S.M.C. and the
Battalion and among the Chinese community. Of course,
a few undisciplined members of the Russian Regiment were
the ringleaders in this affair. The S.M.C. should get
rid of these ringleaders and exercise control over the
brainless members of the Russian Regiment so as to avert
further unfortunate incidents.
The present case of assault of two pupils

《大美晚报》（社论）：

就孤军问题向工部局进言

数日前，在孤军营内发生了一起事件，一名工部局商团义勇队俄国团成员无理殴打了两名前来慰问该营的学生。俄国团的这种行为令人同情正在努力应对局势的工部局。
我们诚恳地提出以下建议，并希望工部局予以采纳：
孤军是应第三方要求，为了租界的安全而撤入公共租界的。从法律角度来看，他们并非战俘，明智的工部局自然也不会将该营视为战俘。据我们所知，在过去12个月的拘禁期间，租界当局一直对该营持尊重态度。
在孤军营因悬挂中国国旗引发事件时，工部局谨慎处理了局势，事件得到了令人满意的解决。这证明工部局对孤军毫无敌意。毫无疑问，是一些无耻之徒为了在工部局与孤军之间以及华人社群中制造不良情绪，才侮辱了孤军。当然，俄国团中少数纪律涣散的成员是此次事件的始作俑者。工部局应清除这些头目，并对俄国团中那些头脑简单的成员加以管控，以避免进一步的不幸事件发生。
目前这起殴打两名学生的事件表明，俄国团的暴力倾向有所增加。幸运的是，由于谢晋元上校采取了适当行动，未发生严重骚乱。除非改善对孤军营的守卫状况，否则营地内的局势将不稳定。我们真诚希望工部局尽快设法补救局势，并防止此类事件在营地内再次发生。

THE AFFAIR OF THE "LONE BATTALION" : LOCAL YOUTHS
ISSUE MANIFESTO

According to the latest information, the incident involving the "Lone Battalion" will soon be satisfactorily settled.
With a view to accelerating a settlement of the incident, the local youths yesterday issued the following manifesto:-
"The 300 men of the Lone Battalion detained in the Kiaochow Park have been insulted, whipped and even killed. They eventually went on a hunger strike as a protest. The affair has broken the hearts of our brethren in this 'isolated island'. The unreasonable action of the authorities in preventing the hoisting of our national flag in our own territory is an insult not only to the Lone Battalion but also to every Chinese. We must support the men of the Lone Battalion.
"Brethren, let us use the blood of the 4,000,000 Chinese in this locality to wipe out this unprecedented humiliation and at the same time submit the following demands:-
1) That the men of the Russian Regiment, S.V.C., be withdrawn.
2) That the assailants be severely punished.
3) That the injured officers and men of the Lone Battalion be well treated.
4) That compassionate grants be issued to the families of the deceased soldiers.
5) That Colonel Tia Tsing-yuan (谢晋元 ) and other military officers of the Battalion be sent back to their camp.
6) That the public be allowed to send comforts to the men of the Battalion.*

July 30, 1938.
Morning Translation.

Morning Leader and other local newspapers publish the following open letter, addressed by Col. Zia Tsing-yuan (謝晉元), Commander of the "Lone Battalion", to the people of Shanghai:-

OPEN LETTER FROM COMMANDER OF LONE BATTALION TO THE PEOPLE OF SHANGHAI

This letter is written in reply to many enquiries which I have received recently from my fellow-countrymen concerning our daily lives.
Nine months have elapsed since we withdrew from the Four Banks' Godown in accordance with an order issued by General Chiang Kai-shek at the request of a third party. During these nine months we have received worse treatment than prisoners from the authorities of the International Settlement; not only have we had no freedom of movement, but many kinds of unreasonable restrictions have been placed on us. We do not know on what legal basis the authorities of the International Settlement are detaining us here. International Law cannot be applied because no war has been declared between China and Japan. Furthermore, a number of Japanese troops withdrew into the International Settlement under pressure at an early stage of the hostilities but they were released by the International Settlement authorities a few days later. We have not forgotten the bloody lessons learned in the Hongkew District of the International Settlement in the January 28 and in the present hostilities. Thus, the International Settlement has lost its neutrality.
The public are greatly mistaken if they think that we can do nothing without arms. Righteousness and justice are our weapons, and my 300 men are ready to be turned into dangerous explosives at any time in defence of the honour of our country and of our soldiers. We would rather lose our lives than submit to any Imperialists.
We are interned on a piece of vacant ground, about ten mow in area, opposite No.40 Singapore Road. The land was used for dumping garbage and is unlevelled. Visitors, after stating their intention to a member of the Russian Detachment, S.V.C., and to our orderly on duty at the gate, will at once be led inside. Visitors may call at any time and there is no limitation on the number of visitors, so long as they are led by a responsible person. Decision in this regard rests with me and no other party may interfere. In the case of persons who visit us frequently, passes can be issued to avoid the trouble of having to wait at the gate, but the number of such passes is limited.
The funds for our maintenance during the past nine months were supplied by local benevolent organizations. These funds are exhausted. Our accommodation is crowded and poorly built. It leaks in rainy weather and the floor is easily flooded. There are absolutely no sanitary conveniences. But all this does not trouble us.

《晨报》及其他本地报纸刊登了以下由“孤军营”指挥官谢晋元上校致上海市民的公开信：—

孤军营指挥官致上海市民的公开信

此信旨在回复近期同胞们就我们日常生活所提出的诸多询问。
自奉蒋介石将军应第三方请求所发布的命令，从四行仓库撤退以来，已过去九个月。在这九个月中，我们从公共租界当局那里受到的待遇比囚犯还要恶劣；我们不仅没有行动自由，还受到许多种不合理的限制。我们不知公共租界当局拘禁我们于此有何法律依据。国际法无法适用，因为中日之间并未宣战。此外，在敌对行动初期，一批日军在压力下撤入公共租界，但几天后便被公共租界当局释放。我们未曾忘记在一·二八事变及此次敌对行动中，公共租界虹口地区所吸取的血的教训。因此，公共租界已失去其中立地位。
如果公众认为我们没有武器便无能为力，那便是大错特错。正义与公理是我们的武器，我的三百名士兵随时准备化作危险的炸药，以捍卫我们国家和军人的荣誉。我们宁死也不愿屈服于任何帝国主义者。
我们被软禁在新加坡路40号对面的一块空地上，面积约十亩。该地曾用于倾倒垃圾，地面不平。访客在向义勇军（S.V.C.）俄国分遣队成员及门口值勤的传令兵表明来意后，将立即被引入内部。访客可随时来访，只要由负责人带领，人数不限。此事由我决定，其他方面不得干涉。对于经常来访者，可发放通行证以免去在门口等候的麻烦，但此类通行证数量有限。
过去九个月维持我们生活的资金由本地慈善团体提供。这些资金现已耗尽。我们的住所拥挤且简陋。雨天漏雨，地板易被水淹。完全没有卫生设施。但这一切并不困扰我们。

pages.en:
July 30, 1938. Morning Translation.

We have two meals a day and these are cooked
by ourselves. The vegetables, rice, firewood etc. are
sold to us by people. We have certain hours for lectures
and work each day. The rest of the time we engage in
sports. We have one football ground, one basket-ball
ground, one volley-ball ground, one tennis court, one
ping pong table, and other equipment for exercises. We
have also a harmonica group. The Y.M.C.A shows us a
motion picture once a week. Among ourselves we have
formed a co-operative society for the sale of daily
necessities.
When I received the order to withdraw, I
thought we could pass through the Settlement to the Western
District, but we were disarmed by the British soldiers.
I was never more enraged than on that occasion. It
marked the beginning of an inhuman and miserable life for
me. From October 31 last year to May this year I have
been suffering from loss of sleep. Neither Chinese nor
foreign style doctors could improve my conditions until
the last two months. Now I am better.

我们每日两餐，由我们自己烹饪。蔬菜、大米、柴火等由民众卖给我们。我们每天有固定的讲课和劳作时间。其余时间我们进行体育活动。我们有一个足球场、一个篮球场、一个排球场、一个网球场、一张乒乓球桌以及其他锻炼器材。我们还有一个口琴队。青年会（Y.M.C.A.）每周为我们放映一次电影。我们在内部组建了一个合作社，出售日常必需品。
当我接到撤退命令时，我以为我们可以穿过租界前往西区，但我们被英军缴了械。我从未像那次那样愤怒过。那标志着我非人且悲惨生活的开始。从去年10月31日到今年5月，我一直遭受失眠之苦。中外医生均无法改善我的状况，直到最近两个月。现在我好多了。

关于一名被拘禁的中国士兵从新加坡路营地逃脱一事。

1939年2月21日凌晨2时25分，毕韦尔路站（B'well Station）打来电话称，他们刚收到消息，一名被拘禁的中国士兵从新加坡路营地逃脱。

刑事侦缉处警员173号及本人立即赶赴现场，并从担任警卫军官的义勇军（S.V.C.）俄国团达维德齐克（Davydzik）中尉处获悉，1939年2月21日凌晨1时05分，他被被拘禁营第三连连长当 Dien 少校（Major Daung Dien (音译)）告知，其手下有一名士兵逃脱。

经讯问当 Dien 少校，他称据其手下报告，一名名叫萧景琪（Shiao Kyung Kyi (音译)）的列兵，年龄约22岁，无锡人，身高约5英尺2英寸，圆脸苍白，短发，中等身材，身穿中国军队列兵的卡其制服和帽子，脚穿黑色胶鞋，于1939年2月20日晚上11时通过攀爬营地无人看守的南墙逃离营地。

Immediately he was informed of the escape Lieut.
Davydzik sent search parties into the Kiaochow Road Park
and vicinity but nothing was found.
The undersigned also searched the park but without
success.
Only one Chinese watchman was on duty in the park
during the night of 20/2/39 and when questioned he was
unable to supply any useful information.
The escaped man's comrades were interrogated and
from them it was learned that the escaped man had at one
time been employed as a park butcher's assistant in
Nantao prior to the hostilities and that he has no known
relatives in Shanghai and had frequently expressed the
desire of returning to Wusih.
It is suspected that several of the man's comrades
were concerned in assisting him to escape as they were
all aware of the escape and all stated that they believed
he intended to return to Wusih.
The description of the escaped soldier has been
circulated as has a request that all station carefully
checked their curfew arrests.
Enquiries proceeding.

1939年2月20日夜间未在此处部署警卫。
达维德齐克中尉在得知逃脱消息后，立即派遣搜索队进入胶州路公园及周边地区，但一无所获。
本人也搜查了公园，但未成功。
1939年2月20日夜间，公园内只有一名中国更夫值班，经讯问，他未能提供任何有用信息。
对逃脱者的同伴进行了审问，从中得知，该逃脱者在敌对行动开始前曾在南市受雇为公园屠夫的助手，他在上海没有已知亲属，并曾多次表示希望返回无锡。
怀疑有几名该士兵的同伴协助其逃脱，因为他们都知道逃脱一事，且均表示相信他打算返回无锡。
已分发该逃脱士兵的特征描述，并要求各警局仔细核查宵禁期间的逮捕人员。
调查正在进行中。
